podcast.body: Released in 1992, this entire album was dedicated to remixes of The Cure's songs. Robert Smith, the band's frontman, was a great admirer of the remix concept, leading to dozens of his band's tracks being revitalized through this approach. "The Cures Robert Smith loved the concept of remixes so much that he had dozens of Cures songs revitalized this way, releasing an entire album of remixes called Mixed Stop in 1992."
